steps.title: Prepare Salt Solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve the specified salts in the indicated volumes of water.

substeps.instruction: Mix the solutions in the order indicated
Complete the final volume to 1L using distilled water

steps.title: Prepare Iron-EDTA Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a combined iron and EDTA solution.

substeps.instruction: Gradually add 270mg of Ferric chloride hexahydrate (FeCl3-6H2O) to 10mL of 0.1N HCl
Gradually add 372mg of Titriplex III dihydrate (EDTA-Na2) to 10mL of 0.1N NaOH
Complete the final volume to 500mL using sterile water

steps.title: Prepare Secondary Salt Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve the specified salts in the indicated volumes of water.

substeps.instruction: Mix the solutions in the order indicated
Complete the final volume to 1L using sterile water
Store in the refrigerator for up to 6 months
Before use, dilute 10 times with sterile water and filter through a 0.2 micron filter

steps.title: Final Medium Assembly
steps.instruction: Combine the autoclaved nutriments and filter the final medium.

substeps.instruction: Under a hood, add the previously autoclaved nutriments (excluding vitamins)
Filter the medium using a 0.2 micron filter
